description: Determines whether a business must file the Italian INTRASTAT summary listing and how often (monthly / quarterly / no obligation), from the amounts of the four previous quarters, and computes the period DEADLINE (25th of the following month, moved when it falls on a Saturday, Sunday or Italian national holiday). Each flow has its own threshold and criterion, returned together with the legal SOURCE: sales of goods and services rendered €50,000 with an EXCEEDS criterion (>) → monthly if exceeded, otherwise quarterly; purchases of services €100,000 and purchases of goods €2,000,000 (threshold raised from €350,000 from reference period 01/2026, Det. ADM 84415 of 03/02/2026) with an EQUAL OR GREATER criterion (>=) → monthly if reached, otherwise NO obligation (for purchases the quarterly frequency was abolished). The > / >= asymmetry is intentional and mirrors the sources. Indicative: it does not replace the accountant or customs broker. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

ammontari_trimestri_precedenti.description: Amounts in EURO of the four PREVIOUS quarters for that flow+category, ordered from most recent to oldest (e.g. [62000, 41000, 38000, 35000]). From 1 to 4 values allowed: a business that started recently has fewer, and the response flags it in the notes. The threshold is assessed on the MAXIMUM, not on the sum.

anno.description: Year of the REFERENCE period (not of the filing). The current forms apply from 2022. It decides which INTRA-2bis threshold applies (2,000,000 from 2026).

categoria.description: Category of the transactions (beni = goods, servizi = services). Threshold and form section depend on it.

flusso.description: 'cessioni' = outgoing transactions, INTRA-1 forms (goods sold / services rendered); 'acquisti' = incoming transactions, INTRA-2 forms (goods purchased / services received).

mese.description: Month of the reference period (1–12). If the frequency turns out quarterly, the quarter is derived from this month.
